# Cognitive Class

> > Free, comprehensive online learning platform offering hands-on AI, machine learning, data science, and cloud computing courses with industry-recognized certifications.

Cognitive Class provides accessible, beginner-friendly to advanced learning paths in artificial intelligence and data science, powered by IBM and industry partnerships. The platform combines guided projects, hands-on labs, and digital credentials to help learners build practical skills in emerging technologies.

## Key Topics

- Artificial Intelligence
- Machine Learning
- Generative AI
- Large Language Models
- Deep Learning
- Data Science
- Python
- PyTorch
- Computer Vision
- Natural Language Processing
- Reinforcement Learning
- IBM Cloud
- Hands-on Projects
- Guided Learning Paths
- ChatGPT

## Getting Started

- [Welcome](https://cognitiveclass.ai): Free online learning platform offering AI, cloud, development, and data science courses with certifications.
- [Cognitive Class Learning Hub](https://cognitiveclass.ai/learn): Main learning hub featuring AI agents, RAG systems, deep learning, and guided projects.
- [Courses and Guided Projects](https://cognitiveclass.ai/courses): Comprehensive course catalog covering AI, cloud computing, data science, and enterprise tools.

## AI and Machine Learning Courses

- [Fundamentals of AI](https://cognitiveclass.ai/learn/fundamentals-of-ai): Introductory AI course covering machine learning, deep learning, and AI ethics basics.
- [Machine Learning Basics](https://cognitiveclass.ai/learn/machine-learning-basics): Beginner machine learning course with PyTorch, TensorFlow, and hands-on Python projects.
- [Learn AI Hands-on - Generative AI](https://cognitiveclass.ai/learn-ai-hands-on-generative-ai): Hands-on learning path for generative AI, LLMs, and prompt engineering with ChatGPT.
- [Learn AI Hands-on - Reinforcement Learning](https://cognitiveclass.ai/learn-ai-hands-on-reinforcement-learning): Beginner-friendly reinforcement learning course with Monte Carlo methods and OpenAI Gym.
- [Computer Vision Hands-on with PyTorch](https://cognitiveclass.ai/learn/computer-vision-hands-on-with-pytorch): Hands-on computer vision course with PyTorch covering image classification and detection.

## Data Science and Advanced Topics

- [Data Science Fundamentals](https://cognitiveclass.ai/learn/data-science): Foundational data science course covering methodology, tools, and core concepts.
- [Applied Data Science with Python](https://cognitiveclass.ai/learn/applied-data-science-with-python): Specialization path in Python data science covering analysis, visualization, and ML.
- [Learn AI Hands-on - Time Series](https://cognitiveclass.ai/learn-ai-hands-on-time-series): Time series analysis and forecasting course using Prophet for temporal data patterns.
- [Enhancing Applications with Embeddable AI](https://cognitiveclass.ai/learn/integration-of-embeddable-ai): Course on integrating AI into applications using OpenAI, IBM Watson, and chatbots.

## Credentials and Recognition

- [Badges](https://cognitiveclass.ai/badges): Digital badge and credential system powered by IBM and Credly for skill certification.

## Enterprise Solutions

- [Business](https://cognitiveclass.ai/business): Enterprise solutions offering custom training portals and workforce development programs.
